svg.title: React in the constant-temperature mixer
svg.desc: Conceptual stage diagram. Vented tube in a temperature-controlled mixer; heater symbol is conceptual.
svg.text: React at 60 °C for 40 min until black Te disappears, a white
precipitate appears at the bottom, and the solution becomes
light purple. No subsequent solid separation is stated.
Conceptual stage diagram. Vented tube in a temperature-controlled mixer; heater symbol is conceptual.
